name: canadian-adventure-camp
description: Canadian Adventure Camp website and Sanity Studio

scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir studio build
scripts.verify:typegen: pnpm typegen && git diff --exit-code -- studio/schema.json frontend/sanity.types.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && pnpm --dir studio typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:typegen && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_BUILD=1 pnpm --dir frontend test:smoke
